review.assessment: The change introduces a new `solution.ts` file containing only a stub for `mergeIntervals`, which immediately returns an empty array without processing the input. This leaves the required algorithm completely unimplemented and directly causes the acceptance test to fail.

findings.actual: The function body executes `return []` regardless of input, so overlapping intervals are never merged or returned.
findings.defect: Stub implementation returns an empty array instead of merging overlapping intervals.
